subject: MAP Kickoff: CardioTech POC — roles, thresholds, and schedule
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Alice Ramos <alice.ramos@cardiotech.com>, Ben Chou <ben.chou@cardiotech.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-10-30T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: MAP Kickoff: CardioTech POC — roles, thresholds, and schedule

Hi Alice / Ben —

Thanks again for taking the call earlier. Per our conversation, we put together a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (attached) to align on success criteria, benchmarking approach, and owners for prompts/evals for the CardioTech POC. Key items in this kickoff message:

- Success criteria (proposed):
  * Response correctness on curated clinical QA set >= 90%
  * Hallucination rate <= 2% (manual review on flagged responses)
  * Embedding retrieval accuracy (top-1) >= 88% on subset
  * Latency p95 <= 400ms for 512-token context (hosted config)
- Benchmark plan: curated clinical QA (2k examples), synthetic edge-cases (300), and integration smoke tests (end-to-end). See bench-spec-v1.xlsx attached.
- Owners:
  * Prompt bank & eval orchestration — Marissa Cole, Redwood
  * Model/infra validation & metrics collection — Neha Kapoor, Redwood
  * Customer-side data/mapping & procurement contact — Alice Ramos, CardioTech
- Timeline:
  * Bench harness + initial prompt set due: 2027-11-03
  * First evaluation run complete: 2027-11-10
  * PO / commercial sign-off target: 2027-11-15

Please review the attached MAP and bench spec. Two asks for this thread: (1) confirm the owners above and (2) call out any must-have acceptance gates for your team that we should add. If these look good we’ll schedule a 30-min sync next week to walk through the bench and the test harness.

Thanks — looking forward to getting started.

—Jordan
Jordan Blake
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference

Attachments:
- MAP-CardioTech-2027-10-30.pdf (PDF)
- bench-spec-v1.xlsx (Excel)

Thanks Jordan — this is a solid start. Quick items from our side:

- Confirmed owners: Simone Patel (procurement) will run commercial approvals; I’ll be the PM for data and acceptance.
- On success criteria: we agree on the correctness and hallucination targets, but would like to see an additional gate for clinical safety (no high-risk hallucinations in any of the 100 flagged examples).
- Dataset access: we can share a de-identified subset by 2027-11-02; can your team confirm a secure S3 path and any minimal encryption/KMS requirements?

Attaching our internal SOW excerpt for reference (SOW-CardioTech-excerpt.pdf).

Best,

Adding technical notes on metrics and instrumentation:

- Metrics we will capture automatically per eval run:
  * Exact-match / F1 (QA set)
  * Hallucination flag rate (model vs. ground truth divergence heuristics + manual review)
  * Latency distribution (p50/p95/p99) with request size buckets
  * Token consumption and cost estimate per run
- Acceptance thresholds (proposed final):
  * QA F1 >= 90%
  * Hallucination manual-false-positive <= 2% across 500 random samples
  * Latency p95 <= 400ms (hosting on Redwood hosted tier)
- Secure data transfer: we can provision a short-lived S3 bucket with KMS encryption and a scoped IAM role for CardioTech. Please confirm preferred key policy; we support customer-managed keys if required.

I’ll attach the bench-spec worksheet (bench-spec-v1.xlsx) to the Drive link for reference.

Neha

Great — appreciate the quick responses and the SOW excerpt, Alice. Recap and next steps (action owners in parentheses):

1) Data handoff: CardioTech to upload de-identified subset to S3 by 2027-11-02 (Alice) — Redwood to provision KMS-scoped bucket and IAM role (Neha).
2) Prompt suite + harness: Marissa to deliver initial prompt set by 2027-11-03; Neha will integrate scoring into harness and run initial evaluation by 2027-11-10 (first run).
3) Clinical safety gate: we’ll add the "no high-risk hallucinations in 100 flagged examples" check to the bench-spec (agreed) and instrument manual reviewer workflow (Marissa / Alice to coordinate SMEs).
4) Commercial timeline: Simone to provide PO timeline; Vivek to track discount cadence with commercial team (Vivek).

I’ve attached the updated MAP and bench-spec to the Drive link above. If no objections, I’ll book a 30-min sync on 2027-11-04 at 10:00 AM PST to walk through the harness and acceptance gates.

Thanks all —
Jordan
